description: GEMS-1 sensor built by Orbital Microsystems (OMS). The curves are the channel spectral response functions distributed by the EUMETSAT NWP SAF for the RTTOV radiative-transfer model, converted from frequency to wavelength; bands chNN follow the RTTOV channel order.
short_description: Orbital Microsystems GEMS-1 channels (NWP SAF RTTOV SRFs)
facility_description: RTTOV platform OMS (EUMETSAT NWP SAF list of supported platforms).

links.label: NWP SAF SRF page for RTTOV sensor oms_1_gems1
NWP SAF spectral response functions index

licence.terms: No terms of use are stated on the NWP SAF SRF pages or in the files. The NWP SAF SRF index lists sensors whose 'SRFs cannot be published due to licence restrictions' separately; this sensor's SRFs are published there.
licence.scope: EUMETSAT NWP SAF distribution of originator data (see notes). Hosted under Nill's 2026-10-26 'host everything' decision.

notes: NWP SAF README_SRF: 'Data obtained for the GEMS-1 sensor built by Orbital Microsystems (OMS) Date received: 19/08/2020 Data used is sampled data at 100 points accross the frequencies. Text file contains the frequency (GHz) and the passband weights (normalized to one).' Zeros added just inside gaps between separate passbands. Pivots agree with the page's central frequencies within 1% except double-sideband channels, whose pivot lies between the sidebands. DetectorType energy is assumed.
